name: Investigator
summary: You notice clues people leave behind.
dirInvest: Your target has a bulletin board in their house filled with clues. They must be an Investigator

name: Lookout
summary: You watch people's front door from your window.
dirInvest: Your target has a spyglass next to their window. They must be a Lookout

name: Psychic
summary: You have been gifted tarot cards representing different towns people.
dirInvest: Your target has a deck of enchanted tarot cards. They must be a Psychic
